prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: one continuous top-down, ground-only terrain outpaint for Safety Last.

INPUTS: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 2944 × 1666 landscape template. The top 260 pixels are actual adjoining terrain from the two existing works sections. The white area below is missing land to the SOUTH. Fill only the missing land. Preserve the topmost 132 pixels exactly, and keep the entire existing top contact, road entries, material scale and proportions fixed. Image 2 is the approved ground material/style reference. Image 3 is the geographic guide only: this land is the southern works and scrap outskirts, not the whole map.

ROUTES WITH OPEN SPACE: Two existing dirt tracks enter from the TOP, near 27% and 83% of the image width. Match their actual positions, widths and direction precisely. Continue the wider LEFT track gently south for a short distance, then let it broaden naturally into an irregular expanse of worn compacted earth around the lower-left / left-centre. This is open work ground where separate salvage scenery can later stand, not a neat circular turning area, not an abrupt square road end. The smaller RIGHT trail should wind modestly down through the right-hand side and leave the BOTTOM near 82% width. Keep that trail narrow and understated. Do NOT connect the two tracks with another road: there is already a connection in the existing terrain to the north. No crossroads, loops, extra branches, paved road, roadside borders or road along the edges. Leave the whole central belt and much of the lower-left freely explorable grass and earth without paths.

GROUND: The new area should gradually become deeper brown and cool umber soil, with quiet compacted grey-brown work ground on the left and irregular muted olive/green grass patches through the centre and right. Large calm patches of plain dirt and low grass matter more than decorative texture. Fewer loose pebbles than the reference, very sparse tiny gravel at the track edges. Keep exact flat top-down hand-painted game style and fine material scale, neutral overhead daylight. Natural irregular transitions into the existing top edge, no straight tint band, no uniform orange cast. Preserve the few orange leaves already in the top-left reference strip but do not extend them into the new area. No new red/orange leaves or flowers.

NO structures, foundations, fences, rails, machinery, crates, scrap piles, trees, shrubs, raised grass tufts, large rocks, water, puddles, people, animals, vehicles, cast shadows, text, grids, borders, panels, vignette, black fades or remaining white gaps. Ground and the two necessary dirt approaches only. Output one opaque landscape image at 2944:1666 aspect ratio, highest available resolution, ideally 2944 × 1666 or larger.

prompts.stage: Soften the straight material transition at the northern contact
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly generated southern ground for Safety Last, 1667 × 943. Image 2 shows the exact neighbouring top contact and blank original outpaint template. Image 3 is a material scale reference.

Make one targeted correction: remove the visible straight horizontal change of ground texture where the old top strip ends, around 15–16% of image height. Keep the TOP 8% of Image 1 absolutely unchanged so exact registration can be preserved. In the band between approximately 8% and 35% of image height, continue the upper earth/grass material at the SAME fine scale and blend it into the quieter new ground through irregular natural grass patch contours and subtle soil changes. There must be no straight horizontal line, distinct rectangular strip, sudden change in pebble size, or row of abruptly chopped grassy patches anywhere across that join. Keep the quieter lower ground mostly unchanged. Do not replace the line with a blurred band: paint coherent crisp material and irregular shapes crossing it. Neutral brown soil, subdued olive grass, fewer scattered pebbles gradually farther from the old contact.

Keep BOTH dirt approaches at their exact positions, widths and slopes; preserve the broad left clearing and narrow right trail. Do not add or move roads. Keep the same flat top-down style, scale, lighting, canvas dimensions and framing. Preserve the existing top-left orange leaves within the unchanged top contact; let the texture below them resolve into plain earth naturally, without extending a carpet of leaves. No new red/orange leaves, flowers, props, buildings, trees, shrubs, water, rocks, text, borders, gradients to black or vignette. This is a seamless material transition correction only. Output the same 1667:943 landscape aspect ratio at highest available resolution.
